# Pilotariak — Developers

> Developer index for Pilotariak: the public Frontis GraphQL API and the Azkena MCP server for Basque pelota data. Parent index: https://pilotariak.com/llms.txt

## When to use

- Query clubs, competitions, categories, specialties or match results for the LCAPB, LIDFPB or CTPB leagues → Frontis GraphQL.
- Give an AI assistant tool access to the same data → Azkena MCP.

## Frontis GraphQL API

- Endpoint: https://frontis-gateway.pilotariak.com/graphql (POST, JSON, no authentication, read-only)
- Required header: `X-Pilotariak-League: lcapb | lidfpb | ctpb`
- Queries: clubs, club(id), competitions, competition(id), categories, category(id), specialties, specialty(id), results(competitionId, specialtyId, categoryId, phase), result(id), version
- Errors: GraphQL `errors[]` with `message` and `extensions.code` (BAD_REQUEST, GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED)
- [graphql-api skill](https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/agent-skills/graphql-api/SKILL.md): full reference with examples (~0.8K tokens)

## Azkena MCP server

- Endpoint: https://mcp.pilotariak.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, MCP 2026-07-28, OAuth 2.1 + PKCE)
- Tools: list_competitions, list_clubs, list_categories, list_specialties, list_results (all take `league`)
- Rate limit: 60 requests/minute per IP
- [auth.md](https://pilotariak.com/auth.md): credential walkthrough (~1.2K tokens)
- [mcp-server skill](https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/agent-skills/mcp-server/SKILL.md) (~0.5K tokens)
- [Server card](https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json) (~0.1K tokens)

## Docs

- [Developer portal](https://pilotariak.com/developers.md): quickstart, auth, errors, limits (~1.5K tokens)
